armySpecialRules.name: BLOODLINES
armySpecialRules.description: Most Vampires belong to a certain Bloodline, such as von Carstein, Necrach, Lahmian, Blood Dragon or Strigoi. Characters belonging to one Bloodline may not join units belonging to another Bloodline, nor may two characters from different Bloodlines join the same unit.

armySpecialRules.name: THE GENERALS OF UNDEATH
armySpecialRules.description: If your army contains any Undead units, you must include at least one character that is a Wizard that uses the Lore of Necromancy.

armySpecialRules.name: Slain General
armySpecialRules.description:
At the end of the phase in which the General is removed as a casualty, and at the start of every friendly turn thereafter, all friendly Undead units (excluding mounts) on the battlefield must take a Leadership test. If the test is failed, the unit immediately suffers a number of Wounds equal to the amount by which it failed the Leadership test, with no saves of any kind allowed. These Wounds are distributed as if from a shooting attack.
If, at the start of any of your turns following the death of the General, there is one or more friendly Wizard Characters on the table who know spells from the Lore of Necromancy, no unit in the army needs to take this Leadership test while at least one of them remain.

armySpecialRules.name: Battle Standards
armySpecialRules.description: In addition to the normal rules for the army battle standard, units of Undead within 12" of their battle standard suffer D3 Wounds less than they normally would due to the Unstable special rule, or following the death of the army's General.

armySpecialRules.name: Characters and Units
armySpecialRules.description: Characters who are not Undead may join Undead units despite not being Unstable themselves. Mounted Characters ignore the Undead special rule of the mount. If an Undead unit would get destroyed as a result of Unstable, any remaining character(s) will need to take a Break test as normal the same phase, using the Leadership modifier that they lost the combat by.

armySpecialRules.name: DEATH SHRIEK
armySpecialRules.description:
A Death Shriek is a special attack that can be used against a single unit in the Shooting phase, even if the model has marched, charged, or the target is engaged in close combat. This attack has a range of 8" and needs line of sight to its target. If the model is engaged in combat, its Death Shriek may target a unit in base contact.
To resolve a Death Shriek, roll 2D6+3. For each point by which the result exceeds the target unit's Leadership, the target unit suffers 1 Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. Death Shriek is a non-physical Magical Attack and Wounds suffered from it are distributed as if from shooting.

armySpecialRules.name: MASTER OF THE DEAD
armySpecialRules.description: A model with this special rule can use the Invocation of Nehek spell from the Lore of Necromancy to increase units of Skeleton Warriors and Skeleton Archers beyond their starting size.

armySpecialRules.name: SPECTRAL STEEDS
armySpecialRules.description: Mounted models with this special rule gain the Ethereal special rule for the purposes of movement only. They do not suffer the movement penalty for being barded. Whilst a unit with this special rule is joined by a character without the Spectral Steeds or Ethereal special rules, it loses this special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: UNDEAD
armySpecialRules.description: All models with the Undead special rule have the Animated Construct, Fear, and Unstable special rules. However, they may make march moves if they are within the Army General's Inspiring Presence range or are joined by a character with the Lore of Necromancy.

armySpecialRules.name: VAMPIRIC
armySpecialRules.description: Models with the Vampiric special rule have the Fear and Immunity (Psychology) special rules. In addition, models suffer -1 To Wound rolls against them, unless they are using Magical Attacks or Flaming Attacks. However, Vampiric models treat all rivers as Deadly Terrain unless they are mounted.

armySpecialRules.name: THE RED THIRST
armySpecialRules.description: Roll a D6 at the end of each Close Combat phase in which one or more models was slain by a Vampire with this special rule. On a 5+, the Vampire recovers a single Wound, up to their starting value (excluding additional Wounds from mounts). This does not work against Animated Constructs, Daemons, Forest Spirits or Vampires.

magicItems.name: FROSTBLADE
magicItems.description: The wielder gains the Ice Attacks and Multiple Wounds (D6) special rules.

magicItems.name: SKABSCRATH
magicItems.description: The bearer has the Devastating Charge and Frenzy special rules, and all close combat attacks made by the bearer have the Flaming Attacks special rule. In addition, the bearer of Skabscrath gains the Death Shriek special rule.

magicItems.name: SLAKING BLADE
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +1 Strength and Attacks at the end of each close combat phase in which they have inflicted at least 1 unsaved Wound (up to a maximum of +3). This bonus lasts for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: DREADLANCE
magicItems.description: All attacks with this weapon automatically Hit.

magicItems.name: ASP BOW
magicItems.description: All shots from this item are resolved at Strength 4 with the Poisoned Attacks and Sniper special rules.

magicItems.name: SLITTER
magicItems.description: This adds one special attack after the wielder has made their normal attacks. Roll a D3; if the result is higher than the remaining number of Wounds of the target, the target is instantly slain with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: KEENING BONE
magicItems.description: Throwing weapon. All shots with this weapon automatically Hit. Characters may take this item despite not normally being allowed to take throwing weapons.

magicItems.name: REAPER OF SORROWS
magicItems.description: All attacks with this weapon automatically Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF KINGS
magicItems.description: This item makes the model's Killing Blow special rule take effect on a 5+.

magicItems.name: THE BALEFIRE SPIKE
magicItems.description: This item gives the wielder the Devastating Charge and Flaming Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: SHADOW'S EDGE
magicItems.description: For every natural 6 rolled To Hit with this weapon, that Attack has the Ignores Armour Saves and Multiple Wounds (D3) special rules.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF NIGHT
magicItems.description: This item causes any missile attacks targeted at the wearer or any unit they are with to suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: THE FLAYED HAUBERK
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 2+ armour save that cannot be improved by any means.

magicItems.name: HELM OF COMMANDMENT
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. If the wearer is not engaged in close combat at the start of the Close Combat phase, one friendly Undead unit (including mounts) within 12" may use the wearer's unmodified Weapon Skill instead of their own that round.

magicItems.name: THE SCABBING PLATE
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour automatically restores 1 Wound lost during the battle at the end of each round of close combat in which it has inflicted one or more unsaved Wounds.

magicItems.name: THE ACCURSED ARMOUR
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer +1 Toughness, but makes them suffer -1 Weapon Skill and Initiative.

magicItems.name: THE ARMOUR OF BLOOD
magicItems.description: This item allows the wielder to automatically regain Wounds through the Red Thirst.

magicItems.name: THE RED CASKET
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains the Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: WAILING HELM
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save and the Terror special rule.

magicItems.name: THE CADAVEROUS CUIRASS
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer the Immunity (Killing Blow) special rule.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF BONE
magicItems.description: When the wearer fails their first armour save (or if they are wounded by an attack which ignores armour saves), the Armour of Bone crumbles to dust and is destroyed, but the Wound is ignored. This armour may be taken by Necromancers despite them normally not being allowed to take armour.

magicItems.name: THE CURSED SHIELD OF MOUSILLON
magicItems.description: This item causes one enemy model in base contact of your choice to lose 1 Attack. In addition, the bearer gains the Hatred (Bretonnia) special rule, and all models in Warhammer: Bretonnia have the Hatred special rule against the bearer.

magicItems.name: NIGHTSHROUD
magicItems.description: Enemy models in base contact with the wearer lose all Strength bonuses conferred from normal and magical weapons, and are subject to the Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: TALISMAN OF THE NADIR
magicItems.description: All friendly units within 12" of the bearer of this item gain the Magic Resistance (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE GEM OF BLOOD
magicItems.description: The Gem of Blood activates when the bearer suffers their first Wound in close combat (before saves). Roll a D6; on a roll of a 1 the wearer suffers the Wound as normal, and an additional Wound with no saves allowed. On a 2+ the Wound is saved, and is rebounded onto the model that caused it with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: SPLINTERVANE BROACH
magicItems.description: All enemy Wizards within 18" of the bearer of this item suffer -1 to casting penalty.

magicItems.name: WRISTBANDS OF BLACK GOLD
magicItems.description: The Wristbands of Black Gold gives the wearer a Magical Ward (3+) against all missile attacks.

magicItems.name: CHIROPTERAN CLOAK
magicItems.description: If a model attacking the wearer of this item rolls a natural 1 To Hit in close combat, they suffer a Strength 4 Hit.

magicItems.name: CLOAK OF THE WAXING MOON
magicItems.description: The wearer of this item can only be Hit on To Hit rolls of natural 6's.

magicItems.name: THE DERMAL ROBE
magicItems.description: The wearer gains a +1 casting and dispel bonus. In addition, they gain +1 to their channelling rolls.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF RAUKHAMON
magicItems.description: This staff contains the Hellish Vigour spell from the Lore of Necromancy. Roll a D6 each time the Staff is used. On a roll of 1, the Staff is temporarily exhausted and cannot cast this bound spell for the rest of the battle. In addition, all enemy units within 6" of the Staff`s bearer suffer a -1 penalty on their rolls To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: SCEPTRE DE NOIROT
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll one dice of their choice when determining the number of Zombies or Skeletons raised with the Invocation of Nehek and Raise Dead spells from the Lore of Necromancy.

magicItems.name: BOOK OF ARKHAN
magicItems.description: This item casts the Vanhel's Danse Macabre spell from the Lore of Necromancy.

magicItems.name: CARRION WAND
magicItems.description: The wielder counts their Wizard level as being 1 higher than normal.

magicItems.name: THE CURSED BOOK
magicItems.description:
At the beginning of the bearer's Magic phase, the bearer may choose to sacrifice one power dice from the pool. If they do so, roll a D6 on the following chart. Assuming there is a viable target for the indicated spell, that spell is automatically cast at its minimum casting value, requiring no power dice. A dispel attempt can be made as normal.
D6 | Spell Cast
1 | Melkoth's Mystifying Miasma (Lore of Shadow)
2 | The Enfeebling Foe (Lore of Shadow)
3 | The Withering (Lore of Shadow)
4 | Portent of Doom (Lore of Heavens)
5 | Doom and Darkness (Lore of Death)
6 | Soulblight (Lore of Death)

magicItems.name: ROD OF FLAMING DEATH
magicItems.description: Staff. This item casts the Fulminating Flame Cage spell from the Lore of Fire.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF DAMNATION
magicItems.description: If cast successfully, this item casts an augment spell. All Undead models (including mounts) in friendly units within 6" of the bearer gain +1 Attack until the start of the bearer's next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: BLACK PERIAPT
magicItems.description: The Black Periapt allows the bearer to save up to two of his army's unused power dice or dispel dice at the end of any Magic phase, and then add them to his side's power or dispel dice pool at the start of the next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: BLASPHEMOUS TOME
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a +2 casting bonus when using the Lore of Necromancy. However, if they Miscast, they must roll on additional D6 on the Miscast table and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: WYCHLIGHT LANTERN
magicItems.description: This item can be used during any of your Magic phases. Once used, it allows the bearer to cast one of their spells automatically without using any power dice, at its minimum casting value.

magicItems.name: AMULET OF SCREAMS
magicItems.description: Roll a D6 every time an enemy Wizard within 18" successfully casts a spell. On a 1, that Wizard suffer 1 Wound which Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: CRIMSON GEM OF LAHMIA
magicItems.description: Once per magic phase, while casting spells, the bearer of the Crimson Gem of Lahmia can choose to take a Toughness test. If passed, they may re- roll a single power dice of their choice. If failed, they suffer a Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: MIDNIGHT TOME
magicItems.description: This item can be used when the wearer successfully casts a spell with a casting value of 10 or less. When used, the opponent cannot attempt to dispel it.

magicItems.name: MORBHEG'S CLAW
magicItems.description: The wearer of this item gains +2 to cast spells if they have not moved that turn or are not engaged in close combat.

magicItems.name: STAVE OF SUFFERING
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a +1 casting bonus for each spell that has successfully inflicted one or more unsaved Wounds the same Magic Phase. This bonus is cumulative.

magicItems.name: MIDNIGHT AMULET
magicItems.description: This item can be used in any of your Magic phases. Pick one enemy unit within 12"; that unit suffers D6 Strength 4 Hits multiplied by the number of the current game turn.

magicItems.name: THE CASKET OF AGES
magicItems.description: The Casket of Ages contains a direct damage spell that targets one enemy model in base contact. The target model suffers one Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. If the Wound is not saved, the victim must pass a Toughness test or suffer an additional Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: TALON OF DEATH
magicItems.description: All enemy models in base contact with the bearer must pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour saves at the start of each round of combat.

magicItems.name: DREADBOLT RING
magicItems.description: For each unsaved Wound the bearer of this item inflicts in close combat, one enemy unit in base contact suffer D3 Strength 3 Attacks with the Flaming Attacks special rule after they have resolved their normal attacks.

magicItems.name: BREATH OF THE VOID MAW
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any Magic phase. Once used, pick one enemy unit within 6" that is not engaged in close combat. Roll a D6; on a 2+ the target unit suffer a number of Strength 5 Hits equal to the roll.

magicItems.name: FRAGMENT OF THE KEEP
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Always Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: THE GRIM GARLAND
magicItems.description: Enemy units in base contact with the bearer must roll 3D6 for their Leadership tests and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: LIGHTSHARD OF THE HARVEST MOON
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any close combat phase. The bearer and any unit they are with may re-roll failed rolls To Hit for the duration of the turn.

magicItems.name: PENDANT OF THE FELL WIND
magicItems.description: The character and any unit they are with gain +1 Movement.

magicItems.name: THE SACCHARINE GOBLET
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any round of close combat. When used, the bearer gains +1 To Hit and To Wound. However, for each of their Attacks that does not inflict an unsaved Wound, they must pass a Toughness test or suffer one Wound with no saves allowed at the end of the combat (before Break tests are taken).

magicItems.name: SIGIL OF THE SANGUINE THRONE
magicItems.description: The bearer and any friendly Vampire unit within 12" may re-roll one of their charge distance dice.

magicItems.name: THE FURIOUS CROWN
magicItems.description: In any turn in which the bearer of this item makes a successful charge, they gain +1 Attack for every enemy model in base contact, up to a maximum of +3.

magicItems.name: GRAVE-SAND SHARD
magicItems.description: This item can be used in any of your Magic phases. Once used, it automatically restores Wounds to any unit they are with following the rules for Invocation of Nehek from the Lore of Necromancy.

magicItems.name: MEDAL OF MADNESS
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule.

magicItems.name: SOULFIRE RING
magicItems.description: For every unsaved Wound caused in close combat by the bearer, they and/or their unit regain 1 Wound, just like a summoning spell.

magicItems.name: BLOOD RIVER CHALICE
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of the controlling player's turn. The model immediately recovers all lost Wounds (ignoring any additional Wounds from mounts) up to their starting value.

magicItems.name: BRAZIER OF NAGASHIZZAR
magicItems.description: The bearer and any unit they join may re-roll failed charge and pursuit distances.

magicItems.name: MIRROR OF ECHOING FAILURES
magicItems.description: Any Wizard within 18" of the bearer that fails a spellcasting attempt (not including dispels) suffers one Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: NATHMAR'S SKULL
magicItems.description: All friendly units of Skeletons and Zombies within 12" of the bearer may March despite being Undead.

magicItems.name: RUBY VIAL
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any of your turns. Until the start of your next turn, all enemy units within 18" of the bearer suffer -1 to their Movement.

magicItems.name: SIGNET OF THE FIRST COURT
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: THE BILIOUS DECANTER
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any close combat phase. The bearer gains the Frenzy special rule and +1 Attack for the remainder of the game. However, they will automatically fail any Berserk Rage tests and must always Pursue.

magicItems.name: ORB OF ENCHANTMENT
magicItems.description: One enemy model in base contact (chosen by the bearer) must take a Leadership test at the start of each round of close combat. If failed, they may not attack this turn.

magicItems.name: TALISMAN OF THE LYCNI
magicItems.description: Model on foot only. The bearer of this item gains +4 to their Movement value and the Swiftstride special rule. In addition, they may join units of Dire Wolves.

magicItems.name: HEART OF THE GIANT FEAST
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any close combat phase. The bearer can re- roll failed To Wound rolls for the duration of the turn.

magicItems.name: SHARD OF NIGHT
magicItems.description: This item may be used at the start of any round of Close Combat. When it is, the bearer suffers 1 Wound with no saves allowed. In exchange, they gain +2 Strength for the duration of this round of close combat.

magicItems.name: THE DRAKENHOF BANNER
magicItems.description: May only be taken if your army includes a von Carstein Vampire Character. All Undead models (excluding mounts) in the unit carrying this standard gain the Regeneration (4+) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE FLAG OF BLOOD KEEP
magicItems.description: May only be taken if your army includes a Blood Dragon Vampire Character. The unit carrying this standard gains a Magical Ward (4+) against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE BARROWS
magicItems.description: All Wights in the same unit as this standard receive +1 To Hit in close combat. This does not apply to mounts.

magicItems.name: HELL BANNER
magicItems.description: All enemy units with Line of Sight to this standard suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. This standard has no effect on models with Immunity (Psychology).

magicItems.name: CURSED PENNANT OF MOUSILLON
magicItems.description: May only be taken if your army includes a Blood Dragon Vampire Character. Any enemy unit that is in base contact with the unit carrying this standard must re-roll 6's when rolling To Hit, To Wound and when taking armour saves.
magicItems.restriction: Blood Dragon, Skeletons, Wights or Blood Knights

magicItems.name: BANNER OF DOOM
magicItems.description: All Undead models (excluding mounts) in the unit carrying this standard gains the Regeneration (5+) special rule against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE DEAD LEGION
magicItems.description: All Undead models (including mounts) in the unit carrying this standard counts as having twice their actual Unit Strength in close combat.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF HELLFIRE
magicItems.description: This banner contains the Flaming Sword of Rhuin spell from the Lore of Fire. It can only be cast on the unit carrying this standard.

magicItems.name: THE FLAYED PENNANT
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: INFERNAL STANDARD
magicItems.description: The model carrying this standard gains the Hold Your Ground (6) special rule.

magicItems.name: ROYAL STANDARD OF STRIGOS
magicItems.description: May only be taken if your army includes a Strigoi Vampire Character. Strigoi or Ghoul only. The unit carrying this standard gains the Hatred special rule.

magicItems.name: THE SCREAMING BANNER
magicItems.description: Enemy units on base contact with the unit carrying this standard must pass a Leadership test at the start of each close combat phase. If failed, they require 6’s To Hit for the duration of the phase.

magicItems.name: ICON OF VENGEANCE
magicItems.description: Any Undead model (including mounts) in the unit carrying this standard that is slain in close combat may immediately make an additional Attack, even if they have already attacked this turn.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF HELLISH VIGOUR
magicItems.description: May only be taken if your army includes a Necrarch Vampire Character. The unit carrying this standard may March despite being Animated Constructs.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE ENDLESS NIGHTMARE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard counts as having one more rank than normal for the purpose of combat resolution.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF EVERLASTING DEATH
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard suffers one fewer Wound than they normally would due to the Unstable special rule.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF NECROMANCY
loresOfMagic.attribute: When a spell from the Lore of Necromancy is successfully cast, all Undead units (excluding mounts) within 6" of the caster regain 1 Wound (Core Units regain D3 Wounds) following the rules for Invocation of Nehek.

spells.name: INVOCATION OF NEHEK
spells.description: Invocation of Nehek is a summoning spell with a range of 18" that targets Undead (excluding mounts). The target immediately regains a number of Wounds as follows: Core Units gain 2D6 Wounds; Special Units (except Cavalry) gain D6 Wounds. Characters, Special Units that are Cavalry and Rare Units regain D3 Wounds per successful casting. Models gained are distributed as a summoning spell. Any characters in a unit can only be healed if targeted separately from the rest of the unit, in which case only they are healed.

spells.name: HAND OF DUST
spells.description: Remains in play. Hand of Dust is an augment spell that is cast on the Wizard itself. While the spell is in effect, the caster gains an additional special attack in close combat that does not benefit from any other magic items or special rule. If this Attack Hits, the target suffers an automatic Wound with the Ignores Armour Saves and Multiple Wounds (D6) special rules.

spells.name: VANHEL'S DANSE MACABRE
spells.description: Vanhel's Danse Macabre is a conveyance spell with a range of 24" that targets Undead (including mounts). The target can immediately make a normal move as if it were the Remaining Moves sub-phase (including any Characters in the unit).

spells.name: HELLISH VIGOUR
spells.description: Hellish Vigour is an augment spell with a range of 18". All Undead models (including mounts) in the unit gain the Always Strikes First special rule and may re-roll failed To Hit rolls in Close Combat until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: FOUNTAINS OF BLOOD
spells.description: Fountains of Blood is a hex spell with a range of 24". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, all failed To Wound rolls made against this unit may be re-rolled. In addition, Vampires gain a +1 to bonus to any The Red Thirst rolls for Wounds caused against this unit.

spells.name: DEATHLY CABAL
spells.description: Deathly Cabal is an augment spell with a range of 18". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, the target gains the Fear and Magical Ward (6+) special rules.

spells.name: GAZE OF NAGASH
spells.description: Gaze of Nagash is a magic missile with a range of 24" that causes 2D6 Strength 4 hits.

spells.name: RAISE DEAD
spells.description: Raise Dead is a summoning spell with a range of 18" that brings a unit of Zombies into play. Roll 2D6+3. This is how many models comprise the new unit. The caster can choose to summon 2D6+3 Skeleton Warriors with shields instead. If they do so, the casting value is increased to 12+.

spells.name: UNQUIET SPIRITS
spells.description: Unquiet Spirits is a direct damage spell with a range of 24". The target suffers 3D6 Strength 2 hits with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

spells.name: MALEDICTION OF NAGASH
spells.description: Malediction of Nagash is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target halves their Strength (rounding down) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: SPIRITUAL VORTEX
spells.description: Remains in play. Spiritual Vortex is a summoning spell with a range of 24" that summons the 5" template. While the spell is in effect, the template counts as Dangerous Terrain, and enemy units within 6" of it suffer -1 to their Leadership.

spells.name: CURSE OF YEARS
spells.description: Remains in Play. Curse of Years is a hex spell with a range of 18". When cast, roll a D6 for every model in the target unit – on a score of 6 the model suffers a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. At the end of the next Magic phase, roll again for each model in the unit, they will suffer a Wound on a 5+, and so on, to a maximum of 2+.

spells.name: WIND OF UNDEATH
spells.description: Wind of Undeath is a direct damage aura spell with a range of 12". Each unit within range suffer 2D6 Strength 3 Hits which Ignores Armour Saves.

vampiric_powers.name: RED FURY
vampiric_powers.description: For each unsaved Wound caused by the model in close combat, it can immediately make an additional Attack (to a maximum of +3 Attacks). These additional Attacks do not benefit from Red Fury.

vampiric_powers.name: UNHOLY REGENERATION
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Regeneration (4+) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: CURSE OF THE REVENANT
vampiric_powers.description: The model has a 3+ invulnerable save when they have a single Wound remaining (if the model suffers multiple Wounds in a single turn, it is reduced to 1 Wound and may then attempt to take this invulnerable save).

vampiric_powers.name: FEAR INCARNATE
vampiric_powers.description: All enemy units in base contact with the model must pass a Leadership test at the start of each round of close combat or suffer -1 To Hit this round.

vampiric_powers.name: FLYING HORROR
vampiric_powers.description: Thе model gains the Fly (10) special rule and may join units of Fell Bats.

vampiric_powers.name: SUPERNATURAL HORROR
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Terror special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: TRANSFIX
vampiric_powers.description: At the beginning of the Close Combat phase, select one model in base contact with the Vampire. The victim must pass a Leadership test or get reduced to Weapon Skill 1 for the duration of this round of Close Combat phase and all attacks directed against the victim will hit automatically.

vampiric_powers.name: HUNTER IN THE DARK
vampiric_powers.description: The model has the Scouts special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: UNBENDING WILLPOWER
vampiric_powers.description: Units of Undead within 6" of one or more models with this power suffer one less Wound than they normally would due to the Unstable special rule or following the death of the army's General. Note that this is not cumulative with the Battle Standard.

vampiric_powers.name: HONOUR OR DEATH
vampiric_powers.description: After issuing or accepting a challenge with a model with this power, the enemy character must take a Leadership test. If failed, the enemy model will automatically refuse the challenge following the normal rules.

vampiric_powers.name: AURA OF DARK MAJESTY
vampiric_powers.description: All enemy units within 6" of one or more models with the Aura of Dark Majesty suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. This penalty is cumulative with any other modifiers.

vampiric_powers.name: SPECTRAL ATTENDANTS
vampiric_powers.description: All enemy Wizards within 18" of the model must re- roll successful channelling results.

vampiric_powers.name: WALKING DEATH
vampiric_powers.description: Any unit in base contact with the model must re-roll successful Break tests.

vampiric_powers.name: CALL WINDS
vampiric_powers.description: Call Winds is a hex aura spell with a range of 24". Until the start of caster's next Magic phase, all enemy missile attacks fired from within or at a target within range suffer -1 To Hit.

vampiric_powers.name: EARTH BIND
vampiric_powers.description: The model and any unit they join gain the Magic Resistance (1) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: SUMMON CREATURES OF THE NIGHT
vampiric_powers.description: This Vampire can use the Invocation of Nehek spell to heal and increase units of Dire Wolves, Bat Swarms and Fell Bats beyond their starting size, even though they are not all Undead.

vampiric_powers.name: WOLF FORM
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains Movement 9 and the Swiftstride special rule. In addition, they may join units of Dire Wolves.

vampiric_powers.name: WOLF LORD
vampiric_powers.description: The model allows all friendly units of Dire Wolves within 24" of it to March.

vampiric_powers.name: WELLSPRING OF DARK MAGIC
vampiric_powers.description: The model and all friendly Wizards within 12" gain +1 to cast spells from the Lore of Necromancy.

vampiric_powers.name: SPECTRAL FORM
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Ethereal special rule. However, it may not join non-Ethereal units or take any magic items.

vampiric_powers.name: MASTERY OVER FLESH
vampiric_powers.description: When casting the Invocation of Nehek, Vanhel's Danse Macabre, Hellish Vigour or Raise Dead spells from the Lore of Necromancy, the model may re-roll all the initial casting dice (unless they have rolled a Miscast).

vampiric_powers.name: UNHOLY CYNOSURE
vampiric_powers.description: Once per Magic phase, the model can re-roll one of the dice rolled to cast a spell. This can be used to negate a Miscast result or could cause an Ultimate Power result.

vampiric_powers.name: FORBIDDEN LORE
vampiric_powers.description: The model has the Loremaster special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: DARK ACOLYTE
vampiric_powers.description: The model adds +1 to the number of Wounds healed (Core Units regain +D3 Wounds) whenever it successfully casts Invocation of Nehek.

vampiric_powers.name: NEHEKHARA'S NOBLE BLOOD
vampiric_powers.description: The model adds +6" to the range of all their spells (excluding auras).

vampiric_powers.name: MASTER OF THE BLACK ARTS
vampiric_powers.description: A player using a model with the Master of the Black Arts power can re-roll the result when it is determining the strength of the Winds of Magic in each of your Magic phases.

vampiric_powers.name: DOOMRIDER
vampiric_powers.description: The model and any Cavalry unit it is with can re-roll failed charge distances.

vampiric_powers.name: DREAD KNIGHT
vampiric_powers.description: While fighting in a challenge, the model will gain +1 To Hit and To Wound.

vampiric_powers.name: WARRIOR PRIDE
vampiric_powers.description: The model can re-roll failed armour save results of 1.

vampiric_powers.name: HEART PIERCING
vampiric_powers.description: The model can re-roll To Wound rolls of 1 in close combat.

vampiric_powers.name: MASTER STRIKE
vampiric_powers.description: The model has the Killing Blow special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: MIGHT OF ARMS
vampiric_powers.description: The model can re-roll To Hit rolls of 1 in close combat.

vampiric_powers.name: STRENGTH OF STEEL
vampiric_powers.description: The model has the Devastating Charge and Mighty Blow (1) special rules.

vampiric_powers.name: BLADEMASTER
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Parry (6+) special rule, even while mounted.

vampiric_powers.name: FURIOUS CHARGE
vampiric_powers.description: In any turn in which the model makes a successful charge, they have the Ignores Armour saves special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: MASSIVE MONSTROSITY
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains +2 Wounds and becomes Monstrous Infantry. It should be placed on a 40x40mm base.

vampiric_powers.name: LOATHSOME STENCH
vampiric_powers.description: All enemy units in base contact with the model suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill.

vampiric_powers.name: IRON SINEWS
vampiric_powers.description: The model may re-roll failed To Wound roll.

vampiric_powers.name: TERRIBLE BLOWS
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: GHOULKIN
vampiric_powers.description: One unit of Crypt Ghouls may be deployed as Scouts.

vampiric_powers.name: INFINITE HATRED
vampiric_powers.description: The model's Hatred special rule applies in every close combat round, not just the first.

vampiric_powers.name: MONSTROUS MASS
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Immunity (Killing Blow, Multiple Wounds) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: RAVENOUS
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Frenzy special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: SUMMON GHOULS
vampiric_powers.description: The model allows one unit of Crypt Ghouls to deploy as Ambushers.

vampiric_powers.name: SEDUCTION
vampiric_powers.description:
At the beginning of the Close Combat round, after challenges have been issued and/or accepted, select a model in base contact with the Vampire. The selected model must take a Leadership test with a -1 modifier. If the test is failed, the victim is controlled by the Vampire player in that Close Combat phase.
The model will direct its attacks against his own side. The model cannot be attacked by either side in that Close Combat phase but, after combat resolution has been worked out, it reverts immediately to the original player's control and can therefore use his Leadership for any Break tests and can be broken and pursued as normal.
If the model has no friendly models in base contact, it is unable to attack in that Close Combat phase and all attacks directed against the victim will hit automatically.
If the Vampire was in a challenge with a model that it takes control of, the challenge ends and both models may attack other targets as normal.

vampiric_powers.name: LIGHTNING REFLEXES
vampiric_powers.description: Enemies must re-roll successful rolls To Hit in close combat against this model.

vampiric_powers.name: NIGHT CREATURE
vampiric_powers.description: If this model is a lone character, it cannot be targeted by enemy missile attacks or spells unless it is within 12".

vampiric_powers.name: INNOCENCE LOST
vampiric_powers.description: The model has the Always Strikes First special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: DOMINATION
vampiric_powers.description: All enemy units in base contact with this model must re-roll successful Leadership tests (except Break tests).

vampiric_powers.name: QUICKBLOOD
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Dodge (5+) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: BEGUILE
vampiric_powers.description: At the beginning of the Close Combat round, all units in base contact with the model must take a Leadership test with a -3 modifier. If the test is failed, the Vampire can only be Hit on 6's this turn.

vampiric_powers.name: SWIFTNESS
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains Movement 10 and the Swiftstride special rule.
